features.title: Admin route group
features.summary: Nested routes under admin with AdminGuard and child paths for users, roles, qr-codes, email.
features.content:
## app-routing.module.ts

Locate the `admin` parent route. Children include `users`, `roles`, `qr-codes`, `email-configuration`, `system-settings`. Extend here when adding operator tools.

features.title: Users and roles
features.summary: UserList, CreateUser, UserRoles, RoleList, CreateRole components.
features.content:
## Identity

These screens call your identity APIs (paths vary by deployment). Cross-check network tab for exact controller names when documenting integrations.

features.title: QR code administration
features.summary: Operator views: QRCodeList, QRCodeView, QR type list and form.
features.content:
## qr-codes/

`qr-code-list`, `qr-code-view`, `qr-type-list`, `qr-type-form`, `qr-code-config` help operators inspect tenant QRs without using the owner wizard.

features.title: QR type templates
features.summary: QRTypeListComponent and QRTypeFormComponent manage type metadata and icons.
features.content:
## Assets

Icon/image URLs may resolve via `{baseApiUrl}/content/{path}` when stored server-side (see qr-type-form).

features.title: Email configuration
features.summary: EmailSettings and EmailTemplates for transactional mail.
features.content:
## email-configuration/

Central place to adjust SMTP or provider settings and template bodies used by backend jobs.

features.title: System settings
features.summary: SystemSettingsComponent for global toggles and policy values.
features.content:
## Settings

Coordinate with backend — many fields map 1:1 to configuration tables or feature flags.

features.title: Admin vs QR owner
features.summary: AdminGuard routes are for operators; owner flows use AuthGuard on qr-codes list and wizards.
features.content:
## Separation

Do not mix concerns: tenant users edit their QRs under `/qr-codes`; platform admins use `/admin/...`.

features.title: Serving /content assets
features.summary: Admin references uploaded icons via baseApiUrl/content/...
features.content:
## CDN / API

Ensure reverse proxy serves `/content` from the same host as SmartQRApi or configure CORS and absolute URLs.
